Banh restaurants to experience in Hue
Sep 2026 • Family
Located at 11-15 Pho Duc Chinh Street, Hue City, Quan Hanh is a familiar address for food lovers who like Hue cakes.

Hanh Restaurant is spacious, with two floors and many dining tables. The main clientele of the restaurant are tourists, so the restaurant is especially crowded during lunchtime and evenings on holidays and weekends.

The plus point of the restaurant is that it serves a variety of Hue cakes such as banh loc, banh beo, banh nam, banh khoai, and banh ram it. In my subjective opinion, the quality of the cakes here is only average. Besides cakes, the shop also has spring rolls, grilled pork vermicelli, fried rice, and stir-fried noodles.

If you are a tourist visiting Hue, Quan Hanh can also be considered a culinary experience worth trying.

Highly recommended: eat well, pay little
Apr 2026 • Friends
Recommended by the guide (and in these cases I usually distrust), otherwise I do not think we would have chosen it.... and we would have made a big mistake. A la carte or 5-course menu options. In 4 we choose 2 menus + 2 a la carte dishes, all delicious and without garlic, with vegetable, meat and fish options. All typical Vietnamese dishes. Very kind staff, especially the head of the room who watched us discreetly, intervening to show us how to compose and eat the dishes. Add 3 beers and 2 bottles of water for a bill that does not reach 5 euros per person. What else!?!?
